parameters.query: withdrawal from event cancellation refund entry fee

stream.answer:
I can't withdraw Junior Consent from the Taiwan Open of Surfing. Entries can't be withdrawn on the website, in the app or by me. To withdraw, please contact the WSL Regional Office or the event's tour manager.

Before you do, here's what the rule book says about refunds:
- **Medical refund:** If you cancel with the Regional Office at least seven days before the event starts and send a valid medical certificate, you get the entry fee back minus a $50 admin fee. This is Rule 2.18 (2026 WSL Rule Book, p.36).
- **No refund after confirmation:** Once a surfer has been entered and charged the entry fee, refunds aren't available. This is Rule 2.17 (2026 WSL Rule Book, p.35).

The sooner you contact them, the better your chance of getting part of the fee back.
